fields.why: The Work Group's own pooled RRs are risks (binary/categorical); the headline efficacy claim rests on manufacturer VE computed from events over person-time, which supports count/rate if cited estimates count toward claims.

The only adjustment is the manufacturer's ('Estimates adjusted for participant age and region'), a cited estimate; the report's own pooled RRs are crude vaccine-vs-placebo contrasts. V3(a) excludes cited methods only for limited reports; extending it to all data_focus levels would decide this.
Methods name 'A systematic review of published and unpublished evidence' and GRADE; v5 maps these to review or synthesis, not mixed/other.

brief_issues: V3(a) (methods behind cited estimates are not the article's) is written for data_focus limited only; ACIP reports that are 'yes' through Work Group pooling but cite adjusted manufacturer VE need the same rule stated for all levels.
